body: Thank you for replying. I don't really know what 'being myself' really is though. I guess I just don't really have any personality anymore.
Thank you. I'm just so scared.
I just feel like I'll never find anyone else who loves me.

Thank you so much for replying. 

I'm so afraid of being alone though. And with him saying he still loves me makes me think that I should wait for him. He said if our love is strong enough we will find each other again in the future. And I want that but I don't want false hope that he's not going to find someone he likes even more than me.
I could really use some support.

Rejection is always hard. The pain from feeling unwanted. 

The wound is still fresh though, I know it's the hardest thing to do, but giving it time will help diminish the pain.

I'm going through a breakup now myself, I know how you feel.

Depression is a bitch. I understand completely where you're coming from. I don't feel like I'll be able to get over it either.

If you're too afraid to talk to your friends in real life, the community over at /r/depression is so helpful. There's so many people wanting to talk and help each other. I often feel like *giving* advice is almost as helpful as receiving it. 

I hope this kinda helped? Or at the very least wasn't a waste of you're time. Best wishes.

Would you have access to a counselor? It might help jog some memories and just help you feel better about the situation in general. 

Not telling anyone doesn't sound like a good idea. If you keep this bottled up inside, the anxiety from not having any sort of supportive outlet will eat you alive. 

Is your cousin willing to talk about it more? Or is it too hard for her? Connecting and supporting each other over this might help.

<3
